data.narrative:
Shield AI, a Series G defense and security company that has raised $1.5B+, is assessed against a comparison universe of 10 same-sector peers spanning similar valuation tiers, including 8 private companies (Anduril Industries at $61.0B, Helsing at $18.0B, Castelion at $13.0B, Saronic at $9.2B, and Quantum-Systems at $8.0B) and 2 public comparables.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.25x step-up multiplier to the last post-money valuation of $5.6B, yielding $7.0B. Peer-median analysis across the 10-company cohort produces a median implied valuation of $7.8B, though the peer range is wide ($3.0B to $61.0B), reflecting significant heterogeneity in stage and market positioning within the defense sector.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $6.0B (low) to $8.9B (high), with a median of $7.4B. The current stated valuation of $12.7B sits materially above both methods' implication. Key uncertainties include the wide dispersion among peer valuations, the applicability of stage-progression multiples in a capital-intensive sector, and whether Shield AI's specific product positioning or customer concentration justifies a premium to peer medians.
